text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi ruk gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, aur humne bataya nahi.
Bas unhi ansuni khwahishon ke darmiyaan,
Humne tumhe khamoshi se chahna seekh liya.
title: Ankahee
description: A soft and heartfelt expression of silent love that remained unsaid between two hearts.
